title: The Concept Explainer With Multiple Framings
description: Explains a concept through the lens of multiple disciplines — for instance, "explain risk" with framings from Finance, Marketing, Real Estate, and Management — so faculty can pick the framing that fits or use the contrast as the teaching moment.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Concept Explainer With Multiple Framings, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
